description: This source file defines the ConfigStore enum which manages configuration data, including remote and local loading/saving, with support for overrides and actor synchronization.

classes.name: OverrideStore
classes.description: An actor class that manages the override settings for configuration, allowing setting and updating overrides.

methods.name: _testSetOverrides
methods.description: Test method to set override configurations during debugging.

methods.name: _testClearOverrides
methods.description: Test method to clear override configurations during debugging.

methods.name: isRemoteMode
methods.description: Determines whether the current mode is remote, considering overrides and the app state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the configuration data, either from remote or local sources, based on current mode and overrides.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided configuration, either remotely or locally, considering overrides.

methods.name: loadFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches configuration data from the remote gateway.

methods.name: saveToGateway
methods.description: Sends configuration data to the remote gateway.
